findings: require-null-check-with-typeof-object (first-ever review, rule count unchanged at 74): hasSameExpressionGuard/hasEarlierExitGuard correctly handle &&-chains in either operand order, OR-chains (correctly still flag, e.g. `value == null || typeof value === "object"` since the OR doesn't short-circuit safely), loose/strict null and undefined equality (`!=`/`==`/`!==`/`===` against null and undefined, including the subtlety that ruling out only undefined is correctly treated as no guard since typeof undefined !== "object" already excludes that case naturally), Boolean()/double-negation truthiness guards, and earlier-top-level-exit guards via exitsUnconditionally. No false-positive or false-negative gap found in this logic after grounding ~250 live typeof-object call sites in actions/setup/js/**/*.cjs (corpus is overwhelmingly disciplined with inline same-expression guards).

Live grounded gap found is NOT in detection logic but in remediability: report_markdown.cjs:320 (`if (typeof value === "object") nodes.push(...value.children...)` inside inline()) and :476 (`else if (typeof value === "object") nodes.push(fromSource({type:"paragraph",children:value.children}))`) are both correctly flagged by the rule today (traced: no same-conjunction guard, no qualifying top-level exit-guard on `value` in their enclosing functions), value is sourced from valueFor(key)=context[key] which can legitimately be JSON null, and would crash on `null.children` - yet both warnings are warn-severity (non-CI-blocking per eslint.config.cjs) and have no suggestion fixer, so they sit untriaged. Filed issue proposing hasSuggestions+suggest (scoped to &&-only rewrite contexts) using these 2 sites as motivation.
